label: Jocoque seco
note: The dried form of jocoque: strained curd dried, or kept in oil as balls

about.text: The dried form of Mexican jocoque: the strained, soured milk is dehydrated into firm curd, similar to Arab labneh, and shaped into 3-4 cm balls that may be kept in olive oil with thyme, dill or mint. Eaten with tostadas.
